finding: Even for the single fixed admissible odd box with bands [1,4],[7,13],[20,24], no fixed constant theta in [0,1] makes F_theta=(-t)(((1-theta)t3+theta*t4)-t)(13-t) pair positively on every required odd circuit for all admissible mixed-band five-node tuples and even boxes. Two explicit all-seven-positive-width all-Hurwitz boxes and two rational node tuples suffice: a Y circuit has strictly negative full pairing at theta=0 and 1/2, so fails throughout [0,1/2]; an X circuit has strictly negative full pairing at theta=1/2 and 1, so fails throughout [1/2,1]. Both have four actual corner atoms plus infinity and exact zero odd moments. This is a direct, complete counterexample to fixed-theta universal-selector proofs, not a no-go for a common numerator; data-dependent or different selectors remain possible.
